model_scope.note: single architecture historically; clean-v3 uses ALL FOUR

oracle_unit: PER_COMPONENT_BBOX (one square crop per native GT component)
boundary_handling: clip to image + zero-pad to side
mask_interpolation: N/A (native GT evaluation; mask never resized in oracle path)
multi_component_rule: one crop per native component; predictions fused across crops
map_back_rule: restore prob to (side,side) bilinear, strip pad, place at clip coords into zero array
fusion_rule: pixelwise MAX of restored component probabilities, threshold AFTER fusion
object_recall_definition: fraction of native GT components with >=1 overlapping predicted pixel
phase12_to_phase13_rationale: Meaningful FULL_FIELD Dice and TINY-component recovery demonstrates exploitable localization/resolution headroom; no claim that predicted ROI will reproduce the Oracle gain.
fp_caveat: Oracle-constrained FP is artificially advantaged and is not fairly comparable to deployable global inference.

ambiguities.detail: restore_crop_probability casts prob to uint8 before bilinear resize
ambiguities.disposition: clean-v3 should restore in float; flagged for supervisor

ambiguities.detail: README claims "+16.2% Dice and 100% tiny recall"; audit gives +12.30 pp and 0.986301
ambiguities.disposition: audit (rank 2) is authoritative over README prose (rank 4)
